key_catalyst: Escalating U.S.-Iran Tensions Drive Oil Higher and Fuel Risk-Off Sentiment
reasoning: Multiple OPEN catalysts are actively escalating: U.S.-Iran tensions have significantly worsened with the ceasefire collapsed, strikes expanding into northern Iran, and Hormuz oil traffic dwindling. Treasury yields reversed higher to 4.60% with the Fed positioned to hike. The semiconductor profit-taking cycle intensified across two consecutive sessions with memory chips bearing heavy losses, and the Nasdaq closed down 1.01% while the Dow rose, confirming ongoing rotation out of tech.
